about: Her fixed lines outside the reply door's own texts: the hand-off bridge and call-back, the limit close, the takeover hand-off, the line when a member who took over drops, the silence close, and the in-call tool hold and failure lines (voice/vpvoice/tools.py). One table per language (the keys of agent-config LANGUAGES), each line a string or {female, male} for languages whose first person is gendered. The runtime renders them for the call's language (the contact's language when the agent allows it, else languages.primary); hinglish follows her script (Devanagari -> hi-IN), as disclosure.json does. Read by product/voice/vpvoice/safety.py fixed_line() and product/tests/safety-fixed-lines.test.ts. Every line passes the reply door (they are doored at runtime too).
